message.content: Recent literature treats skills as modular, reusable capabilities that empower AI agents to perform real-world tasks through tool use. Large, curated skill registries have emerged, including a filtered collection of over 5,400 OpenClaw skills and 345 Claude Code skills, spanning domains such as engineering, marketing, compliance, and research. These skill sets are designed for integration into coding agents and proactive assistants.
